detailedDerivation: Retain H1/F and mortal H2/R source pairs. Their negative source rows t precede the positive owner row a. Their token types are disjoint and all sources have capacity1.

For each mortal owner remove the T paired R tokens. Choose the earliest m=min(|D|,|R|−T) D services and latest m remaining R services. All R dates<p≤all D dates; pairing selected lists preserves capacity and forward time. Unmatched D and R counts are the positive/negative parts of χ=T+|D|−|R|.
Partition actual p-booker hosts by their unique y service: prebirth X, living E−C, postdeath D, or never-y W. Thus |P|=X+(E−C)+D+W and R=|P|−E, proving D−R=C−X−W and χ=C+T−X−W.

On any finite interval each forward matched edge contributes−1 if its negative date is inside and+1 if its positive date is inside. This equals its crossing indicator at the left cut minus that at the right cut. Local finiteness permits summation; unmatched signs give U+−U−.

Therefore Σ(Q+2)=U+−U−+X(l−1)−X(r). The inversion components are Inv+Inv_m; remaining selected D/R crossings add X_DR. Before p the latest R selection minimizes crossings, after p the earliest D selection does; the bijection itself does not change these cut counts. This is not a bound on that minimum.
